posts.name: Pammi Tiwari
posts.cooked:
Respected Sir @sayan

I am repeating only the End Term and OPPE exam in System Commands. However, my course portal is not showing the marks for graded assignments, BTP, and Quiz 1.

Could you please confirm if I am required to resubmit the graded assignments, or if my previous submissions/marks will be considered?

image439×320 21.1 KB

posts.name: PRINCE PATEL
posts.cooked:
22f2001271:

Could you please confirm if I am required to resubmit the graded assignments, or if my previous submissions/marks will be considered?

No, You don’t need to submit Assignments. Just submit BPT for OPPe eligibility only.
Assignments score will be considered from previous term.

posts.name: Pammi Tiwari
posts.cooked: But in other courses where I missed the end term, I can still see the quiz marks and graded assignment marks

posts.name: PRINCE PATEL
posts.cooked: Don’t worry about that. You need to submit only BPT for OPPe Eligibility.
